audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[0..6].side gave Fizz all seven stages while content win[4..6] and the packet levelChart give Azir the last three.
audit.why: Fizz is a 400-550 range champion; once Emperor's Divide exists Azir can wall the only approach he has. The packet chart and the content layer already agree — only the full layer dissented.
audit.corrected: Fizz x4 then Azir x3 on both layers, ratings dropped on the three flipped rows and each why rewritten to argue Azir's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] (Level 3) described Chum the Waters, which is the level 6 ultimate; spikes[2] and mid used the fabricated "Conquer the Sands".
audit.why: Azir's Q is Conquering Sands. Fizz's level 3 spike is Playful/Trickster (16/14/12/10/8), not his ultimate (120/100/80).
audit.corrected: Level 3 restated as the hop unlocking; the fabricated Q name replaced in both fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this lane was absent everywhere: Playful/Trickster GROUNDS, so Azir's Shifting Sands cannot be cast while it is on him. The page only said the hop dodges his combo. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: Fizz E carries both untargetable and grounding flags, and his R grounds too; Azir's E is flagged as a dash that grounding denies. That means his escape and his out are turned off by the same button that dodges his poke — the reason to leave before the hop, not after.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated in tldr, tradeBad, loading, cooldowns and dosFull[0]; real cooldowns added (E 16-8s, Q 8s at 550, W every 3s at max, R 120/100/80).

audit.whatIsWrong: Seastone Trident's auto-attack reset was never given as a timing tell.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell: the empowered auto wind-up is the cue to step back, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Trident's 3s max-rank cadence and reset folded into breakdown.cooldowns and whys[3].
